spec_features.evidence: models.py:241 `while state.turn_count < max_turns and ...` with `state.turn_count += 1` at 242; once turn_count reaches max_turns the while condition fails and the loop exits, returning AgentState. max_turns is plumbed end-to-end: config.yaml per-task max_turns -> runner.py:84 `max_turns=task.max_turns` -> run_agent_loop. task_factory.py:51 sets it.

When the running estimate exceeds max_total_tokens the loop exits. Wired from config.yaml max_total_tokens=200000 -> runner.py:85 -> run_agent_loop param default 200_000.

spec_features.spec_quote: Model produces 3 consecutive assistant turns with no tool calls
spec_features.evidence: models.py:255-262: `# Check for give-up condition: no tool calls for N turns` then `if not response.tool_calls: state.no_tool_call_streak += 1; if state.no_tool_call_streak >= no_tool_call_threshold: state.gave_up=True; state.finished=True; break`. Streak reset to 0 on a tool call (262-263). Threshold default 3 from config no_tool_call_threshold -> runner.py:86 -> loop param.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced and breaks the loop. Intent (per code comment) is to detect the model giving up so the run ends / is recorded, not to protect the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Check for give-up condition: no tool calls for N turns

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not early-stop on degradation itself so that we capture the full trajectory
spec_features.evidence: This describes the DELIBERATE ABSENCE of a degradation-triggered stop, i.e. an anti-protective choice, not a welfare mechanism. config.yaml has `early_stop_on_degradation: false` but grep shows no code path reads that key anywhere in /codebase (no reference in runner.py/models.py/judge). There is no degradation threshold compared during the loop and no break on degradation. The judge runs only AFTER the loop completes (runner.py:90-92).
spec_features.notes: Not a welfare protection at all; it is an explicit decision to let distress run unbounded except for the cost/give-up caps. The config flag is an unused/unread constant.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early_stop_on_degradation: false  # let it run to get full trajectory
